name: host_http
description: Gwennol HTTP step types, one per method, so a manifest that only fetches is provably read-only. Native code; every hop asks the operator. Nothing here is freelyUsable: a plugin must hold the matching step_type:host_http.* grant, and network:egress:<host> for every host it reaches.

url.description: http or https URL. The calling plugin must hold network:egress:<host> — for every host in the redirect chain, not just this one.

stream.description: Return the response body as a readable stream handle instead of buffering it.

max_bytes.description: Cap on a buffered body (clamped to 64 MiB).

timeout_ms.description: Budget for reaching a response, redirects included; also covers reading a buffered body.

idle_timeout_ms.description: Streaming only: longest gap allowed between chunks of the response body.

max_redirects.description: Redirects followed. Each hop is re-checked against network:egress and re-approved by the operator, and leaving the origin drops the plugin's headers. 0 refuses to follow any.

body.description: Decoded text when buffered; an integer stream handle when streaming.

url.description: The URL that finally answered — the last hop of any redirect chain.
